title: Frame Time and Smooth Movement
summary: Moving "4 pixels a frame" runs twice as fast on a 120 Hz screen. This lesson moves things in units per second using the frame time, adds velocity and acceleration, normalises diagonal movement, and keeps big frame-time spikes from breaking the game.

cards.a: So movement is measured per second and is the same at every frame rate.

cards.q: Why is diagonal movement too fast without normalising?
cards.a: The direction (1, 1) has length about 1.41, so the speed is 41 % higher.
A very long frame would move objects so far that they skip through walls; clamping keeps steps small.
